class.name: GameplayEffect
class.brief_description: A data-driven resource that modifies attributes or grants tags.
class.description: GameplayEffects are the primary way to change attributes (damage, healing, buffs) and apply states (tags) to actors in the Gameplay Ability System. They can have different duration policies: Instant, Infinite, or Has Duration.

members.member: The duration of the effect in seconds. Only relevant if [member duration_policy] is [constant DURATION_HAS_DURATION].
Defines how the effect behaves over time.

constants.constant: The effect is applied immediately and then discarded (e.g., instant damage).
The effect persists indefinitely until removed (e.g., permanent passive buff).
The effect persists for a set [member duration] (e.g., 5 seconds of poison).
Adds the magnitude to the attribute.
Multiplies the attribute by the magnitude.
Overrides the attribute value with the magnitude.
